definitions: A single event or a series of events that are threatening in terms of health, safety or well-being of a community or a large group of people.
An event or series of events that represent a critical threat to the health, safety, security or wellbeing of a community or large group of people.
examples: The war has led to a major humanitarian crisis.
Aid organisations are responding to the humanitarian crisis.
There is a growing humanitarian crisis in the region.
